item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 15 / Station A: The City's Legistar pages list the…
item.description: The City's Legistar pages list the amended development agreement (File 260724) and its zoning ordinance (File 260770) as approved by the Mayor and enacted on October 13, 2026 (Enactment Nos. 208-26 and 209-26). The Board gave the ordinances final passage on October 6, 2026 (11 ayes), per the Clerk of the Board's certificate in each file's 'Leg Final' attachment. The summary, an open question and the September 29 timeline entry still said enactment was not confirmed or still to come; they now match the Legistar pages. Both ordinances say 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment' (File 260770 §5(a) and File 260724, in each file's 'Leg Final' attachment), which makes November 13, 2026 the effective date by our count, a legal date computed by Pier & Point and not printed in the text; the heights and uses in the enacted text are not yet checked against this record. The record's timeline now has an entry for the Board's final passage on October 6, 2026 (11 ayes), before the Mayor's approval. Source: SF Board of Supervisors, Legistar, BOS File 260724 and File 260770 (https://sfgov.legistar.com/LegislationDetail.aspx?ID=8127453&GUID=CC4AC1DD-BF51-4585-86E8-0A5D44AA3745); Clerk of the Board's 'Leg Final' attachments: https://sfgov.legistar.com/View.ashx?M=F&ID=16063745&GUID=68B0CE5F-84C2-4368-BF8D-EEA7D8B92E55 and https://sfgov.legistar.com/View.ashx?M=F&ID=16063746&GUID=9EA91A49-BBF9-4471-9EA9-6E7BD33A4353.

item.title: Correction · 1470 Owens Street: A WRNS Studio page titled "UCSF Parking Structure" lists a 2012…
item.description: A WRNS Studio page titled "UCSF Parking Structure" lists a 2012 completion, 10 stories and 627 stalls for what it calls the Owens Street Parking Structure, with no street number. Watry Design lists 1470 Owens as completed in 2020 with 4 levels and 317 stalls, so the WRNS page is treated as a different building; which building it depicts is not confirmed. Source: https://wrnsstudio.com/projects/ucsf-parking-structure/ ; https://watrydesign.com/project/1470-owens-parking-structure ; https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay School: The San Francisco Chronicle reported on August 17, 2026 that…
item.description: The San Francisco Chronicle reported on August 17, 2026 that construction of the school building "wrapped up late last year"; SFUSD had scheduled completion by January 2026. The high school program on the fourth floor draws students from six high schools according to the San Francisco Standard, while the Chronicle counts about 90 students from five high schools enrolled this year. The Registry and the Chronicle put the project at about $129 million to $130 million, while the Standard reports a $95.4 million construction contract. Source: https://www.sfchronicle.com/sf/article/s-f-students-return-school-mission-bay-school-22385475.php ; https://sfstandard.com/2026/08/06/mission-bay-school-opens/ ; https://www.sfusd.edu/about-sfusd/sfusd-news/press-releases/2026-08-07-sfusd-celebrates-milestone-opening-long-awaited-new-school-mission-bay-neighborhood ; https://news.theregistrysf.com/sfusd-cuts-ribbon-on-129mm-82000-sqft-mission-bay-school-san-franciscos-first-new-elementary-in-two-decades/.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 12 West: The 2015 property management plan lists Block 12…
item.description: The 2015 property management plan lists Block 12 West as vacant land, but city permits from 2013 and 2017 describe a warehouse or storage building on the lot, which was recorded as demolished in 2019. A June 8, 2023 presentation proposed an environmental review contract with ICF for Blocks 4 East and 12 West; the presentation lists June 20, 2023 as the planned Commission hearing, while the staff memo asking the Commission to authorize the contract is for its November 7, 2023 meeting, with a not-to-exceed amount of $440,817; no source read says when or whether the Commission voted. The 2018 demolition permit milestone records the permit issue date only. Source: https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf ; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/MEMO_MBS%20Blks%204E%2012W%20ICF%20Contract.pdf ; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20MBS%20Environmental%20Consultant%20Affordable%20Housing%20Sites%206.8.23.pdf ; https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=201712055462.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 4 East: Curtis Development and Bayview Senior Services are…
item.description: Curtis Development and Bayview Senior Services are the developers; Mission Bay 4 East Associates, L.P. is the Phase I entity and Mission Bay 4 East Associates 2, L.P. the Phase II entity. The April 2026 Notice of Exemption says all non-manager units "will be dedicated to lower-income households" at no more than 70% of area median income (HUD and TCAC basis), with regulatory agreements to be recorded before building permits; other sources give 30-80% (up to 95%) of MOHCD median income or 35% to about 95%, and these are not reconciled. The $5,000,000 Phase I loan of February 2026 includes $1,943,150.16 already spent under the 2024 predevelopment loan. The tentative parcel map is dated March 31, 2026 and Public Works issued its approval notice on April 2, 2026; neither creates the lots. Construction start and completion dates are expected dates. Source: https://media.api.sf.gov/documents/2026-0000027_The_Mission_Bay_South_Block_4_East_Project.pdf ; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-08/MEMO_4E%20ENA%20and%20Loan%20Agreement%20with%20Att.pdf ; https://sfocii.org/files/inline-files/2026002.pdf ; https://sfocii.org/files/inline-files/2026004.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Five88 (Mission Bay South Block 7 West): The unit count for Five88 now shows every…
item.description: The unit count for Five88 now shows every figure sources give: 200 total units with 198 affordable (OCII, June 2016), 200 and 198 on two city permits, and 208 on the Assessor roll; none is reconciled. The Assessor roll does record a 2017 year built for the parcel (2023-2025 rolls). No source gives an opening date for Blue Bottle Coffee here; the only source is a 2021 sign permit, which is not an announcement or an opening. Two permits listed under this lot are at 540 Mission Bay Blvd North. Source: https://sfbos.org/sites/default/files/FileCenter/Documents/52912-OCII%20Housing%20Report%20FY%2013-15.pdf.
